title: Finite fractional Liouvillian square-function shell bound
question: Can a fractional power of the bond Liouvillian control finite-time local influence with a local Dirichlet-form target, avoiding the regulator growth of the full commutator norm?

new_perspective.principle: Replace the first Liouvillian derivative by a fractional spectral square function.
new_perspective.motivation: R-365 gives a sharp constant-one bound but leaves ||[B,X]||_HS as the potentially cutoff-growing quantity. The scalar phase factor has the stronger interpolation envelope min(2,|y|) <= 2^(1-theta)|y|^theta for 0<=theta<=1.
new_perspective.qft_bridge: At theta=1/2 the target is a bond Dirichlet or Kubo--Mori square function, which is closer to a local modular/Lieb--Robinson estimate than an unweighted total-energy norm.
new_perspective.non_claim: The fractional norm is still an unweighted finite spectral norm here; no modular weight or uniform limit is assumed.

theorem.setting: Finite Hermitian B with spectral blocks P_a X P_b and Liouvillian L_B(X)=[B,X].
theorem.state_trace: |Tr(omega(U_t^* X U_t-X))| <= ||omega||_HS times the fractional bound <= the fractional bound for a density omega.

verification_contract.lean_scope: finite scalar fractional phase envelope and scope firewall

promotion_boundary: R-366 is only a finite fractional spectral inequality and diagnostic. Promotion requires a source- and volume-uniform modular or Dirichlet-form estimate for the fractional Liouvillian on a common local core.
next_action: Test theta=1/2 against larger cutoffs and volumes, then derive or refute a local Kubo--Mori/Dirichlet comparison for the actual Q3 bond; do not infer uniformity from the finite ratio.
boundary: Finite exact spectral algebra plus V=2 Q3 diagnostics. No local collar, phase-weight, common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, mass-gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure follows.
no_overclaim: Fractional interpolation softens the finite-time phase factor but does not by itself bound the fractional Liouvillian norm uniformly or establish QFT dynamics.
